body.name: Strictly positive common-binary-confounder class
body.construction: \(\mathcal M^{\circ}(P_{\mathrm{obs}},\Gamma_A,\Gamma_0,\Gamma_1)=\{\widetilde P\in\Delta_{\mathrm{full}}^{\circ}:\mathcal L_{\widetilde P}(X,A,Y)=P_{\mathrm{obs}},\;Y=AY(1)+(1-A)Y(0)\text{ almost surely},\;(Y(0),Y(1))\perp A\mid(X,U),\;\zeta_{1,1,x}\zeta_{0,0,x}\leq\Gamma_A\zeta_{1,0,x}\zeta_{0,1,x},\;\zeta_{1,0,x}\zeta_{0,1,x}\leq\Gamma_A\zeta_{1,1,x}\zeta_{0,0,x}\text{ for every }x\in\mathcal X,\;\eta_{a,1,1,x}\eta_{a,0,0,x}\leq\Gamma_a\eta_{a,1,0,x}\eta_{a,0,1,x},\;\eta_{a,1,0,x}\eta_{a,0,1,x}\leq\Gamma_a\eta_{a,1,1,x}\eta_{a,0,0,x}\text{ for every }(a,x)\in\{0,1\}\times\mathcal X\}\).
